title: ensure_live_location_tick scans the open chat's whole loaded history on every frame while no live location runs
trigger: Open any chat with a long loaded history and no running live location; window_upkeep calls ensure_live_location_tick each frame, the tick is None so open_chat_live_location_refresh iterates every message each time
effect: Wasted O(messages) work per frame in the main thread; no visible bug
fix: Scan only when the history changes (a Location message arrives or edits), or hold a LiveShare stage { Idle, Ticking { chat, task } } woken by the update that adds a live share

title: Save As copy runs in a detached cx.spawn; its result note lands on whichever account is on screen
trigger: Message menu > Save As, pick a destination, switch account before the file copy finishes
effect: The 'saved to X' / 'couldn't save' note shows on the other account's screen; the task is not owned by any stage so it is not cancelled on switch
fix: spawn_scoped (screen-owned) so the account switch drops it, or hold the Task in a SaveAs stage on the screen

title: mark_timed_media_read drops a failed open_voice_content send, so the timed media shows with no countdown started
trigger: Open an incoming self-destructing photo or video while the send is refused (client busy or reconnecting)
effect: The viewer opens the media but its timer never starts; nothing says so and it is only retried by closing and reopening
fix: Check the send result and show a note, or hold a TimedOpen { Starting { request } } stage until TDLib marks the timer as counting

title: ViewerExtra::shared_tab and shared_seen only mean something while the viewer source is SharedMedia
trigger: open_shared_media_viewer writes both beside MediaViewer::open_shared; any later open (chat, poll, profile) leaves them as they were; sync_shared_media_viewer guards by source()
effect: No bug today: stale values are ignored behind the source check
fix: Put them in the source variant (ViewerSource::SharedMedia { tab, seen }) so they exist only for that source and reset with it

title: The Marketplace box is open/closed in PaymentUi.marketplace and also in the session's GiftPurchase (Sending vs SendingClosed), closed and reopened by hand together
trigger: close_marketplace_box and open_marketplace_for each change MarketplaceBox and then call gift.close()/gift.reopen() on the live or demo session separately
effect: No bug today; a new closer that updates only one side would leave a purchase marked closed while the box shows (or the reverse)
fix: One owner for 'box shown': derive the session stage's closed variant from MarketplaceBox when the answer arrives instead of mirroring it
